rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges thinning zona/expanded appearance, but it overstates confidence in identifying a strong compact ICM and cohesive TE from this single somewhat collapsed image; some described features are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, BMI/lifestyle, male factor, partner age, and cycle context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around morphology versus age-related aneuploidy risk; only minor overreach is linking A-grade ICM too strongly to euploidy and assigning fairly specific probabilities from limited data.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, no bed rest, caution with add-ons, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A. Minor issue is the claim that PGT-A shortens time to live birth, which is context-dependent.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and what to review if unsuccessful; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
